title: IPAFFS Costs
description: What the environment is costing now: SQL from the databases deployed, AKS from the nodes running, Log Analytics from ingestion, and the other services at their standing rates. Estimates at rates from DEV's own bill; Azure Cost analysis has the actual bill.

options.content: **Estimates from what is deployed now**, at rates from DEV's amortised bill for 1–21 Oct 2026: SQL £2.77 per vCore per day, AKS £14.07 per user node and £1.96 per system node per day, logs £1.69 per GB ingested, and a standing rate for each other service. Together they cover about 99% of AZR-IMP-DEV1's cost. The AKS VMs are on a savings plan bought outside the subscription, so the Actual cost view shows them as almost nothing: compare with Amortized cost. The classic SND servers in AZR-SND are priced at Azure list prices, as their bill is not visible here. For the actual bill, which runs 8–24 hours behind, see [Azure Cost analysis](https://portal.azure.com/#view/Microsoft_Azure_CostManagement/Menu/~/costanalysis/scope/%2Fsubscriptions%2F$subscription).

| where type =~ "microsoft.sql/servers/databases" and name != "master" or type =~ "microsoft.sql/servers/elasticpools"
| extend isPool = type =~ "microsoft.sql/servers/elasticpools", pooled = isnotempty(properties.elasticPoolId)
| extend Namespace = case(
    isPool, "(elastic pool)",
    name in ("approvedestablishment-microservice-blue", "bip-microservice", "bordernotification-microservice", "bordernotification-refdata-microservice-blue", "checks-microservice", "commoditycode-microservice-blue", "countries-microservice-blue", "decision-microservice-blue", "economicoperator-microservice", "economicoperator-microservice-public-blue", "enotification-event-microservice", "fieldconfig-microservice-blue", "in-service-messaging-microservice", "laboratories-microservice-blue", "notification-microservice", "permissions-blue", "referencedataloader-microservice-blue", "soaprequest-microservice"), "dev",
    name startswith "bordernotification-refdata-microservice-blue-", substring(name, 45),
    name startswith "economicoperator-microservice-public-blue-", substring(name, 42),
    name startswith "approvedestablishment-microservice-blue-", substring(name, 40),
    name startswith "referencedataloader-microservice-blue-", substring(name, 38),
    name startswith "in-service-messaging-microservice-", substring(name, 34),
    name startswith "enotification-event-microservice-", substring(name, 33),
    name startswith "bordernotification-microservice-", substring(name, 32),
    name startswith "commoditycode-microservice-blue-", substring(name, 32),
    name startswith "laboratories-microservice-blue-", substring(name, 31),
    name startswith "economicoperator-microservice-", substring(name, 30),
    name startswith "fieldconfig-microservice-blue-", substring(name, 30),
    name startswith "countries-microservice-blue-", substring(name, 28),
    name startswith "decision-microservice-blue-", substring(name, 27),
    name startswith "notification-microservice-", substring(name, 26),
    name startswith "soaprequest-microservice-", substring(name, 25),
    name startswith "checks-microservice-", substring(name, 20),
    name startswith "bip-microservice-", substring(name, 17),
    name startswith "permissions-blue-", substring(name, 17),
    "(other)")
| extend vCores = toint(sku.capacity), daily = iff(pooled, 0.0, todouble(sku.capacity) * 2.77)
| where not(isPool)
| summarize Standalone = countif(not(pooled)), Pooled = countif(pooled), standaloneDaily = sum(daily) by Namespace
| extend k = 1
| join kind=leftouter (
    resources
    | where type =~ "microsoft.sql/servers/elasticpools"
    | summarize poolDaily = sum(todouble(sku.capacity)) * 2.77, k = 1
    | join kind=inner (resources | where type =~ "microsoft.sql/servers/databases" and isnotempty(properties.elasticPoolId) | summarize poolDbs = count(), k = 1) on k
  ) on k
| extend ['£/day'] = round(standaloneDaily + iff(poolDbs > 0, poolDaily * Pooled / poolDbs, 0.0), 2)
| extend ['£/month'] = round(['£/day'] * 30.4, 0)
| project Namespace, Standalone, Pooled, ['£/day'], ['£/month']
| order by ['£/day'] desc
| project Namespace, ['SQL £/day'] = ['£/day']

targets.expr: sum by (Namespace) (label_replace(0.5 * (sum by (namespace) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"^(Running|Pending)$"}) == 1)) / scalar(sum(sum by (namespace) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"^(Running|Pending)$"}) == 1)))) + sum by (namespace) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"^(Running|Pending)$"}) == 1)) / scalar(sum(sum by (namespace) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory"} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () (max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"^(Running|Pending)$"}) == 1))))) * scalar((count(kube_node_info{node=~"^aks-user-.*"}) * 14.07 or vector(0)) + (count(kube_node_info{node=~"^aks-system-.*"}) * 1.96 or vector(0))), "Namespace", "$1", "namespace", "(.*)"))
